message.content:
I don’t know how many drones each customer runs—that’s their own business.

I just see the airspace and the flight corridors between their sites. Some customers have a few drones, others have dozens, but I don’t track that kind of detail.

If they want to know how many drones they’ve got, they’d have to ask their own systems or their own people. My job is just to make sure the airspace info is right for everyone.
